steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The intruder stole your bio-information just now. She will use this disguise to break through all security systems and cause an even larger riot.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You're in extreme danger. Time is running out. Please leave with me now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's because you are the top authority here, the new Chief of <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>—${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You are the top authority here, the new Chief of <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>—${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Not a moment goes by without those <color=#fb9259>rioters</color> wanting you dead.
